recreation_prompt_markdown: Recreate a mobile-first browser canvas platformer titled `Toadstool Trail Builder`. Preserve tile-platformer mechanics: momentum left/right movement with friction, gravity, grounded jumping, AABB grid collision, solid blocks, smaller hazard hitboxes, start markers, goal tiles, death respawn, win modal, story-map selection, course editor, and route-code import/export. Present it as a bright mushroom-kingdom adventure with a red-capped hero, secret question blocks, wobble-goomba hazards, star flags, procedural rolling hills, drifting clouds, chunky arcade UI, family-friendly copy, and portrait-safe touch controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a browser canvas tile platformer with three story levels, a touch-first level editor, route-code import/export, and an active play state. The player accelerates left/right with friction, jumps only while grounded, collides by AABB against a tile grid, dies on hazard contact or falling, respawns after failure, and wins by touching the goal tile.

## Protected mechanic truth
- Canvas runtime with requestAnimationFrame loop.
- Mobile left/right/jump buttons and pointer/touch activation.
- Momentum-based horizontal movement, friction, gravity, grounded jump gate, and jump impulse.
- Tile meanings: solid block, hazard, goal, start marker, erase in editor.
- AABB collision against solids, smaller hazard hitbox, instant goal win, timed respawn after death.
- Story-map, editor, test, import/export, win modal, menu return flows.

## Remix target
`Toadstool Trail Builder` reframes the source as a cheerful mushroom-kingdom course builder: a red-capped trail hero leaps through bright meadows, secret question blocks, wobble-goomba hazards, flag starts, and star goals. Presentation is rebuilt, mechanics are preserved.
